name: Research competitor pricing models
description: A 'web_research' task: research how competitor AI coding assistants price their services.
prompt: Research how AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Cody) price their services. For each: (1) pricing tiers and per-seat cost, (2) any usage-based components, (3) how they differentiate free vs paid tiers. Summarize into a knowledge document with sources.
